Saharanpur Mosque Demolished Days After Court Ruling

A 150-year-old mosque in Saharanpur was demolished three days after a local court declared it illegal. A lawyer has questioned a "withheld" report, stating an inquiry found the land to be Waqf property. The demolition occurred despite the court's ruling that the structure was illegal. Further details on the specific court order and the contents of the inquiry report remain subjects of inquiry.
